_comment: Generic over-firing regression dictionary: short, acoustically-aggressive, PUBLIC developer terms whose canonical spellings collide with ordinary English (CRAN~'ran/cram/crane', Snyk~'sync/sink', Redis~'ready/radish', k8s~'Kate's/crates', worktree~'tree/work', ultrathink~'everything', Sonnet Opus~'bonus/sonnet'). Pairs with bench/corpus/overfire.json (phrases whose references contain NONE of these terms). Run through the biasing arm: any term that appears in the boosted output is a false positive (over-fire). This is the regression gate for FluidAudio bumps — see the pin comment in parleq-app/Package.swift. No proprietary/customer dictionaries live in this repo on purpose.
